findings.evidence: The definition uses only the field inverse `(Nat.card G : k)⁻¹`, and none of the proofs at lines 38–123 invokes the instance. The roadmap's confirmed signature at `CharacterTheory/Suggested.lean:63` likewise defines `characterPairing` without `Invertible`, reserving that hypothesis for nondegeneracy at line 69.
findings.fix: Remove the `Invertible` assumption from the definition and all elementary/formula lemmas; retain it only on the finrank and orthonormality theorems at lines 126–158.
findings.issue: `[Invertible (Nat.card G : k)]` is unused and too strong on `characterPairing`, `characterPairing_apply`, symmetry/linearity lemmas, and the formula-only `ofCharacter`/`ofFDRep` bridges (lines 38–123). The pairing is well-defined over every field, becoming zero when the group order is zero in the field.

summary: The core pairing and its elementary API are unnecessarily restricted to coefficient characteristics coprime to the group order.
